summary: Haoxi Health Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held June 2, 2026. Shareholders approved a share capital increase from US$384,250,000 to US$35,200,000,000,000 by creating additional Class A and Class B ordinary shares, adopted an eighth amended memorandum and articles of association, and authorized a share consolidation at the board's discretion with a cumulative ratio not exceeding 1-for-8,000. These are routine capital structure changes, not a special situation. No event constitutes an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category. The filing is a standard post-meeting report with no transaction, premium, or strategic pivot.
